description: Account number field stored as int64 numeric values ranging from 1001 to 1028. All 30 records are non‑null; 28 distinct values with two duplicates (1001, 1010). Values are uniformly four‑digit numbers. Intended datatype appears to be string, indicating a type conversion may be required.
recommended_actions: [STANDARDIZE] Convert numeric Account_No values to string type while preserving the four‑digit format, e.g., 1026 → '1026'.
